compiled_state.title: RED: tests for deterministic alias computation from wordlist
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: RED

Write failing tests for alias computation in ticket-create.sh. Tests must be RED before T4 implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given: ticket-wordlist.txt exists at plugins/dso/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt; When: file read; Then: contains >= 500 adjective entries and >= 500 noun entries separated by '# NOUNS' header
- Given: same UUID input; When: alias_from_uuid() called twice; Then: returns identical adj-noun-noun string both times (deterministic)
- Given: ticket created; When: CREATE event data.alias field read; Then: matches regex ^[a-z]+-[a-z]+-[a-z]+$
- Given: wordlist file absent; When: alias_from_uuid() called; Then: returns 8-hex fallback (first 8 hex chars of UUID e.g. a3f290bc), logs WARN to stderr

Test file: tests/scripts/test-ticket-create.sh (add new test functions)
Story DD coverage: SC4 (deterministic alias in CREATE event)
Retry budget: 2 attempts

comments.body:
GAP_AC_AMENDMENT: Distinct test function names required.
T1 (8986-4be4) and T2 both add tests to tests/scripts/test-ticket-create.sh as parallel Phase 1 roots. Additional AC: all new test functions in this task must have names prefixed 'test_alias_' (e.g. test_alias_deterministic, test_alias_event_field, test_alias_fallback). This avoids merge conflicts with T1's test_16hex_* test functions when both are committed independently.
